lead: Color picking: the trigger is a swatch that opens a popup with a saturation × brightness area, a hue slider, an optional opacity slider, value inputs and preset colors. The color is kept as HSV inside, so the hue isn't lost when you drag the saturation to 0.

formats.title: Formats
formats.description: The panel switches between HEX / RGB / HSB. `format` sets the inputs shown and the string `onValueChange` gives; `defaultFormat` sets the initial format, `formats` limits the ones you can switch to.

alpha.title: Alpha
alpha.description: With `alpha` there is an opacity slider, and an opacity input in percent (in every format).

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `color-picker.css`. The color is a dynamic value and the component writes no styles: it splits the current color into `--cp-*` variables set on the panel and the swatches, which theme styles use to place the thumbs and draw the gradients.
styling.trigger: The trigger (`data-popup-open` while the popup is open), the swatch and the hex text
styling.panel: The panel in the popup; it carries the `--cp-x` / `--cp-y` / `--cp-hue` / `--cp-alpha` / `--cp-hue-color` / `--cp-solid` / `--cp-color` variables
styling.area: The saturation × brightness area and its thumb, `role=slider`, adjusted with the arrow keys
styling.controls: The preview circle and the sliders next to it
styling.sliders: The hue and opacity sliders and their thumbs
styling.input: The row of inputs (`data-format` is the format) and each input's wrapper (`data-field` is hex / r / g / b / h / s / alpha)
styling.presets: The preset list and each preset (the current color has `data-selected`)
